tasks.title: Create provider category mapping and types
tasks.description: Create `packages/cli/web/src/lib/provider-categories.ts` with the PROVIDER_CATEGORIES constant mapping provider IDs to their category and region. Also export the GroupedProvider type that useProviderGroups will return. Categories: recommended (openai, anthropic, deepseek, google, groq, mistral), coding-plan (kimi-for-coding, minimax-for-coding, zhipuai-coding-plan, alibaba-coding-plan), china (glm, qwen, moonshot, doubao, spark, yi, baichuan, and other Chinese providers), international (xai, perplexity, together, fireworks, cohere, and others). Providers not in the map default to international region.
acceptanceCriteria: PROVIDER_CATEGORIES maps at least 30 provider IDs to category+region
Recommended providers (openai, anthropic, deepseek, google, groq, mistral) have category='recommended'
Coding plan providers (kimi-for-coding, minimax-for-coding, zhipuai-coding-plan, alibaba-coding-plan) have category='coding-plan'
TypeScript types for category and region are exported
Typecheck passes
tasks.notes: Scan models-snapshot.js to identify all provider IDs and classify them. Unmapped providers default to international.

tasks.title: Create useProviderGroups hook
tasks.description: Create `packages/cli/web/src/hooks/useProviderGroups.ts` that takes Provider[] and optional searchQuery string, returns GroupedProviders[] (array of groups with id, label, providers). Logic: (1) if searchQuery, filter providers by fuzzysort on name+id, (2) assign each provider to one group by priority (connected > recommended > coding-plan > china > international > custom), (3) sort providers within each group by name, (4) filter out empty groups, (5) when searching, all groups auto-expand.
acceptanceCriteria: Hook returns groups in correct order: connected, recommended, coding-plan, china, international, custom
Each provider appears in exactly one group
configured providers go to 'connected' group regardless of category
isBuiltin===false providers go to 'custom' group
Unmapped builtin providers default to 'international' group
Empty groups are excluded from results
Search filtering works via fuzzysort on name and id
When searchQuery is active, groups are marked as expanded
When searchQuery is cleared, groups return to default collapsed state
Typecheck passes
tasks.notes: Use fuzzysort (already installed, used in ModelSelector.tsx). Each group in the returned array has: { id: string, label: string, count: number, providers: Provider[], expanded: boolean }.

tasks.title: Create ProviderGroup collapsible component
tasks.description: Create `packages/cli/web/src/components/ProviderGroup.tsx` — a collapsible group component that renders a section title with count (e.g. 'Recommended (6)'), a list of provider cards (reusing existing card styles from SettingsPage), and a 'Show all (N)' / 'Show less' toggle. Default shows first 5 providers, expand to show all. Uses useState for expand/collapse state. Accepts expanded prop to force-expand when searching.
acceptanceCriteria: Group title shows format 'Label (count)'
Default state shows max 5 providers
'Show all (N)' button appears when group has >5 providers
Clicking 'Show all' expands to show all providers and button text changes to 'Show less'
Clicking 'Show less' collapses back to 5 providers
Groups with <=5 providers show all items without toggle button
expanded prop forces the group to show all providers
Empty groups render nothing
Typecheck passes
tasks.notes: Follow the StageColumn.tsx pattern: useState(false) + slice(0, expanded ? all : 5) + toggle button. Reuse existing provider card styles from SettingsPage.tsx.

tasks.title: Refactor SettingsPage with search and grouped provider list
tasks.description: Refactor `packages/cli/web/src/components/SettingsPage.tsx` to replace the three-section layout (ConnectedProvidersList, AvailableProvidersList, CustomProvidersSection) with a unified grouped view. Add a search input at the top of the providers tab with 300ms debounce and Escape-to-clear. Use useProviderGroups hook to get grouped data, render each group with ProviderGroup component. Keep existing dialog components (ProviderConnectDialog, CustomProviderDialog) and provider card actions (connect, remove, test) working as before.
acceptanceCriteria: Search input appears at top of providers tab
Typing in search filters providers across all groups in real-time
Search uses 300ms debounce (not on every keystroke)
Escape key clears search and restores all providers
Empty search results show 'No providers found matching your search'
Searching auto-expands groups that have matches and hides empty groups
Clearing search restores default collapsed state
Provider connect/remove/test actions still work correctly
ProviderConnectDialog opens when clicking connect on a builtin provider
CustomProviderDialog opens from the Custom group's add button
Connected providers appear in top group with remove functionality
Typecheck passes
Build passes (cd packages/cli && npm run build)
tasks.notes: Preserve all existing functionality: connect dialog, remove confirmation modal, custom provider dialog. The refactor is purely structural — same data, same actions, new layout.
